jobs.occupation: General nurses wanted for permanent positions in Norway

Monitoring patients’ vital signs and keeping records of their health progress.    Administering medications and treatments as prescribed by doctors.    Performing blood draws and other routine medical procedures.    Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to deliver optimal care.    Offering emotional support and clear communication to patients and their families.    Working in both hospital and home care settings, adapting to each patient’s individual needs.Qualifications:    Hold a valid nursing authorization from an EU country.    Have previous work experience as a nurse, with a preference for those who have experience in hospitals or community care settings.    Be proficient with basic computer skills, necessary for modern healthcare environments.    Speak and write English fluently. Candidates must also be motivated to learn Norwegian.    Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN).    A driver’s license may be required for certain home care positions.Personal qualities:    Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a team-oriented environment.    A responsible, structured, and flexible approach to patient care.    The ability to remain calm and perform under pressure, handling stressful situations with a professional attitude.    Respect for patients’ individual needs and a compassionate approach to their care.    A strong desire to move to Norway and integrate into Norwegian society, bringing your family along for a rewarding experience.    A genuine passion for nursing, combined with a clear understanding of your professional responsibilities and limitations.    The ability to prioritize tasks and maintain a solution-oriented mindset.What we offer:    Competitive salary packages and pension plans.    A permanent employment opportunity in a supportive and friendly environment.    A clear path for professional growth and development.    Free online Norwegian language courses with a private tutor to ease your transition.    Full assistance with obtaining Norwegian nursing authorization.    Comprehensive support with relocation logistics, including help with accommodation, schools, and childcare for your family.    Guidance from professional headhunters with 19 years of experience, who will assist you throughout the entire process.Why choose Norway?Norway is consistently ranked as one of the best countries in the world for quality of life. Our healthcare system is publicly funded, providing patients with excellent care while offering healthcare professionals a structured and rewarding work environment. Nurses in Norway benefit from clear career progression, strong support from interdisciplinary teams, and the ability to spend quality time with each patient, contributing to better health outcomes. In addition to professional growth, moving to Norway offers a chance to experience a high standard of living, with clean air, a focus on outdoor activities and a family-friendly environment.If you see yourself thriving in this role and want to explore the possibilities of working in Norway, we encourage you to contact us. We look forward to guiding you through the next steps in your journey!

jobs.occupation: Take your nursing career to Northern Norway
jobs.description: Imagine building your nursing career in one of Europe’s most spectacular regions, surrounded by Arctic nature, close-knit communities and a healthcare system where your skills are truly valued.We are recruiting EU-trained nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Finnmark, Northern Norway. You will mainly work within home care services or nursing homes, providing important care and becoming part of an experienced and supportive healthcare team.Moving to another country is a big step, but you will not have to do it alone. We provide free Norwegian language training, assistance with authorisation, relocation support and personal follow-up throughout the entire process.Your main responsibilities include:    Providing home nursing care to patients in their own homes    Working in a nursing home or assisted living facility    Daily patient follow-up, medication management, observation and documentation    Close collaboration with relatives, GPs and other healthcare professionals    Contributing to quality improvement and development of local routinesWe are looking for someone who:    Has a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country    Is motivated to obtain Norwegian authorisation (we assist with the process)    Speak fluent English and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language course    Works independently and in a structured way    Enjoys teamwork and has genuine compassion for patients    Is flexible and able to adapt to different work situations    Holds a driver’s license We offer:    A full-time permanent position    Competitive salary and working conditions    A warm, inclusive and supportive team    Opportunities for professional development    Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher    Relocation assistance and help with housing    Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation processWhy Finnmark?Finnmark is Norway’s northernmost region and offers a different pace of life than larger cities. jobs.occupation: Chef - Sommarøy Arctic Hotel Tromsø
jobs.description:
Chef Wanted for Sommarøy - Seasonal Position with Possibility of Extension
Would you like to work as a chef in the beautiful surroundings of Sommarøy, just outside Tromsø? We are currently looking for a skilled and dedicated chef to join our team at Sommarøy Hotel for an exciting seasonal position.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a kitchen, takes pride in using quality ingredients, and would love to combine work with unforgettable nature experiences in Northern Norway.

The position is full-time (100%), starting in November and running until the end of March, with the possibility of extension.
Job Responsibilities
• Preparing and presenting dinner dishes and à la carte meals.
• Ensuring high standards of food quality and presentation.
• Contributing to the efficient and well-organised daily operation of the kitchen.
• Maintaining high standards of hygiene and following food safety procedures, including HACCP.
• Working closely with the kitchen team and other departments.
• Contributing to a positive working environment and excellent guest experiences.Qualifications
• Experience as a chef in a hotel, restaurant, or similar establishment.
• Experience with à la carte service.
• A professional chef qualification is preferred, but relevant work experience may compensate.
• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
• Good understanding of ingredients, food quality, and kitchen routines.
• Organised, flexible, and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Fluent in either Norwegian or English.What We Offer
• A full-time seasonal position from November until the end of March, with the possibility of extension.
• An exciting working environment surrounded by spectacular natural scenery.
• A friendly and international working environment.
• Staff accommodation available for only NOK 2,500 per month. You will have your own bedroom in a shared house with two other chefs.
• The opportunity to experience Northern Norway, with spectacular landscapes and the Northern Lights right on your doorstep.About Sommarøy Hotel
Sommarøy Hotel is situated in the scenic surroundings of Sommarøy, approximately a one-hour drive from Tromsø. Surrounded by the sea, mountains, and beautiful Northern Norwegian nature, the hotel attracts guests looking for unique experiences throughout the year.

Here, you will have the opportunity to become part of a kitchen team dedicated to creating memorable dining experiences for our guests.
Interested?
We would love to hear from you if you have kitchen experience and are ready for an exciting season on Sommarøy.

Please send us your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

 

We look forward to hearing from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sommarøy Hotel is a unique seaside hotel located on the beautiful island of Sommarøy, just one hour from Tromsø in Northern Norway. Surrounded by stunning Arctic nature, our hotel offers unforgettable experiences all year round, from the Northern Lights to the Midnight Sun. We are an international team passionate about great hospitality, quality food, and creating memorable experiences for our guests.

jobs.occupation: Kayak Guide – Summer in Reine, Lofoten
jobs.description:
Want to spend your summer paddling on the world-famous Reinefjorden, working outdoors and guiding guests through some of Lofoten's most spectacular scenery?

Reine Rorbuer is looking for a certified kayak guide for a 50% position during the busiest part of the summer season.

What we offer:

• 

Work in the heart of Reine

• 

Spend your working days outdoors on the fjord

• 

Meet guests from all over the world

• 

Join a small, friendly and supportive team

• 

Possibility to work more than 50% by combining kayak guiding with shifts in other departments, depending on your experience and our operational needs

• 

We can assist with accommodation during the employment period

We're looking for someone who:

• 

is a certified kayak guide with sea kayaking experience

• 

has a full driving licence

• 

speaks fluent English

• 

is fit, reliable and comfortable working outdoors in changing weather

• 

is service-minded and good with people

• 

is available for the full period 15 June -- 15 August 2027

Additional advantages:

Hospitality experience, Scandinavian languages, photography are an advantage.

Interested?

Send your CV and a short introduction to blaz@reinerorbuer.no, including information about your kayak qualifications and previous guiding experience.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Reine Rorbuer resort, our guided kayak tours, hikes, photo tours and Northern Lights tours help guests experience the extraordinary landscape of Lofoten. Based in the fishing village of Reine, where the mountains meet the Arctic Ocean, we aim to make every activity as memorable for its warm, attentive service as for its setting.

We hold our activities to a high standard, and our guided kayak tours have earned a high guest satisfaction score. We're looking for people who take pride in that standard and are committed to giving every activity guest an outstanding experience.
